faqChanges.from: ## Ready to Protect & Improve Your Website?
faqChanges.to:
### Website Management vs Website Maintenance

People often use these terms interchangeably, but there is a difference. Website maintenance is the technical upkeep — updates, security, backups, and fixes that keep your site online and safe. Website management is broader: it adds ongoing content edits, design tweaks, performance optimization, and SEO health.

In short, maintenance keeps your site working; management keeps it working and growing.

### What Ongoing Website Management Covers

Depending on your plan, this is the work we do to keep your website secure, fast, and growing:

-   Core, plugin & theme updates
-   Security scans
-   Backup verification
-   Uptime & SSL checks
-   Broken link & 404 monitoring
-   Speed & Core Web Vitals audit
-   SEO health check
-   Database optimization
-   Content & design updates
-   Performance & health report
-   Emergency downtime recovery
-   Malware cleanup & hack repair
-   New pages & feature requests
-   Plugin conflict resolution

### Platforms We Manage

Whatever your site is built on, we keep it running. We manage all major platforms and custom-built sites: WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, custom PHP and HTML/static sites. See our [WordPress plans](/wordpress-website-maintenance-packages/), [WooCommerce store plans](/ecommerce-website-maintenance-packages/) and [Shopify plans](/shopify-website-maintenance-packages/).

### Neglecting Your Website Can Lead To

-   **Slow load times:** visitors bounce instantly if pages take too long to load.
-   **Broken pages and errors:** 404 errors and broken forms cost you leads and sales.
-   **Security vulnerabilities:** outdated plugins open doors to malware and hackers.
-   **SEO ranking drops:** search engines penalize neglected, slow, or insecure sites.

### How to Choose a Plan

**Choose Essential if…** you run a blog, portfolio, or small brochure site and want affordable, reliable core care at $79/mo.

**Choose Growth if…** your website drives leads or sales and you want speed optimization, malware removal, monthly reports, and more edit time.

**Choose Business if…** you run a high-traffic site needing 24/7 emergency fixes, staging-tested updates, and priority support.

Running an online store? See [Store plans from $199](/ecommerce-website-maintenance-packages/).

## The 3 Pillars of Website Support: Protect, Maintain, Grow Most articles hand you a long, confusing list of "services." We group everything into three simple pillars, so you can see exactly what you're paying for — and what your website actually needs.
### 1. Protect Security monitoring & malware removal, off-site backups with fast recovery, and uptime monitoring with emergency support — keeping your site safe and online.
### 2. Maintain Software, plugin & CMS updates, speed and Core Web Vitals optimization, and bug fixes for broken links, forms, and layouts.
### 3. Grow Content updates and changes on request, ongoing SEO support to protect rankings, and clear monthly reports with recommendations.
A complete website support plan blends all three. Cheaper plans focus on Protect + Maintain; higher tiers add the Grow pillar. Think of it like servicing a car. You don't wait for the engine to fail; you change the oil and catch small problems early. Website support works the same way: small, regular tasks prevent expensive emergencies later. ## Website Support vs Maintenance vs Management These terms overlap, which causes confusion. Here's the simple distinction: | Term | What It Means | Best Described As | | --- | --- | --- | | Website maintenance | Scheduled, proactive upkeep (updates, backups, security, speed) | Prevention | | Website support | On-demand help when you have a problem or request a change | Response | | Website management | Full hands-off package: maintenance + support + strategy | Done-for-you | The best providers combine support and maintenance into one service, so your site is both well cared for and backed by a team you can reach. ## Should You DIY or Hire a Website Support Service? You can maintain a website yourself — but most business owners shouldn't, for the same reason they don't service their own car. Here's an honest comparison: | Factor | Doing It Yourself | Hiring a Support Service | | --- | --- | --- | | Time | Hours every month | Almost none — handled | | Security | Easy to miss a critical patch | Monitored by specialists | | When it breaks | You're on your own | A team fixes it fast | | Cost | "Free" until an emergency | Predictable monthly fee | If your website earns you customers or revenue, professional support almost always pays for itself by preventing one costly outage or hack. ## How Much Do Website Support Services Cost? Website support services typically cost between $49 and $600+ per month, depending on your site's size, platform, traffic, and how much hands-on help you need. Small businesses typically pay $75–$200/month. | Website Type | Typical Monthly Cost | Best For | | --- | --- | --- | | Small site / blog | $49 – $99 / mo | Core security, updates & backups | | Business / WordPress site | $149 – $299 / mo | Sites that can't afford downtime | | eCommerce / high-traffic | $300 – $600+ / mo | Online stores & critical sites | Price is driven by the number of pages or products, your platform, monthly traffic, how often backups and updates run, and how fast you need support to respond. See transparent options on our [plans and pricing page](/monthly-website-maintenance-packages/). ## How to Choose the Right Website Support Provider Not all support is equal. Use this checklist when comparing providers: - Clear scope — you know exactly what's included at each plan level - Proactive, not reactive — they prevent problems, not just react - Fast response times, especially for downtime and urgent issues - Staging-first updates — changes tested before they hit your live site - Transparent pricing — no hidden fees, no long-term lock-in - Real monthly reporting — proof of what was done - Platform expertise with your CMS (WordPress, Shopify, etc.) Red flags to avoid: vague "we'll take care of it" promises, long contracts with exit penalties, backups stored only on the same server, and no reporting at all. ## Signs Your Website Needs Support Right Now
### It's Slow Pages take more than 3 seconds to load or feel laggy on mobile.
### Security Warnings Browser warnings, expired SSL, or you've been hacked before.
### Things Break Updates break your layout, or you see broken links and form errors.
### It Goes Down Your site has gone offline unexpectedly, costing you visitors.
### No Time You don't have the time or skill to keep it maintained yourself.
### Rankings Slip Search traffic is dropping with no obvious explanation.

### How much do website support services cost?

Website support services usually cost between $49 and $600+ per month. Small sites sit at the lower end, while business and eCommerce sites pay more for faster response, daily backups, and hands-on support.

### Do small businesses need website support?

Yes. Small business sites are among the most common hacking targets because they're often left unmaintained. Affordable support plans give small businesses professional protection without a big budget.

### Can you support a website you didn't build?

Yes. A professional team can maintain and improve almost any existing website, regardless of who built it, as long as they have access to the files, hosting, and admin login.

### Will my website go offline during support work?

Normally, no. Work is planned to avoid disruption for your visitors. On our Business plan, updates are tested on a staging copy first, then deployed to your live site.

### Do website support services include 24/7 help?

Many do. On our plans, 24/7 emergency fixes for critical issues like downtime or a hacked site are on Business.

### How often should a website be maintained?

Most websites should be maintained weekly or monthly depending on size and complexity. Business and eCommerce sites benefit from weekly checks to stay secure, fast, and reliable.
